title: Manager - PMO & Strategic initiatives
description:
FMC Corporation is a global leader in agricultural sciences, driven by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture. Solutions for the Planet. We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting\-edge and next\-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Our employees are at the heart of this innovation. We’re looking for bold thinkers and collaborative doers. At FMC, your ideas matter. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that drives progress in agriculture, supported by a culture that values integrity, safety, respect, and results. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.

**Position Summary:**


The role will serve as a strategic partner to the Managing Director, providing business insights, performance analytics, governance support, and execution tracking across the organization. The incumbent will work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain teams to drive data\-based decision\-making and ensure effective execution of business priorities.


This role requires strong analytical capability, business acumen, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex business data into actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

 **Location: Mumbai**

**Job Responsibilities \-**

**1\. Business Performance Analytics**

* Develop and maintain executive dashboards covering sales, liquidation, collections, profitability, inventory, market share, and other key business KPIs.
* Analyze product\-wise, crop\-wise, and geography\-wise business performance.
* Support monthly business reviews with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Conduct trend analysis and scenario modelling to support business decisions.
* Monitor product performance, volume trends, profitability, and market penetration.
* Develop performance scorecards for sales teams and business units.
* Track strategic priorities and cross\-functional projects sponsored by the MD.
* Drive governance cadence for leadership reviews and business updates.
* Monitor critical action items and ensure timely execution across functions.
* Prepare executive summaries, briefing notes, and decision\-support materials.
* Support annual operating planning, budgeting, and strategic planning exercises.

**2\. Executive \& Board Reporting**

* Prepare leadership presentations, business reviews, and board materials.
* Consolidate inputs from multiple functions into executive\-level reports.
* Translate large datasets into concise business insights for leadership decision\-making.

**3\. Governance \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a central coordination point between the MD and leadership team.
* Follow up with functions on commitments, milestones, and action plans.
* Facilitate cross\-functional alignment and issue resolution.
* Ensure confidentiality and professionalism in handling strategic business information.

**Key Deliverables**

* Weekly MD Dashboard
* Monthly Business Review (MBR)
* Product Performance Scorecards
* Geography Performance Dashboards
* Strategic Initiative Tracker
* Leadership Presentations
* Risk \& Opportunity Assessment Reports
* Annual Operating Plan Support

 **The Candidate (Requirements) \-**

* MBA from a reputed institute (Finance, Strategy, Marketing, Business Analytics preferred).
* 5\-8 years of experience in Business Analytics, Strategy / PMO, Commercial Excellence, CEO/MD Office or Consulting.
* Proven experience in assisting Leadership team
* Excellent Business communication skills – Written \& Verbal communication.
* High proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word)


FMC is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Employment decisions at FMC are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our hiring and employment practices support a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment.

title: Project Procurement Co-Ordinator
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**Position Summary**

The Accounts Payable Specialist is responsible for managing project\-related financial transactions, vendor payments, cost tracking, invoice processing, and GBS tracking for projects. The role ensures compliance with company policies, contractual requirements, accounting standards, and project budgets while supporting accurate financial control throughout the project lifecycle.


The position works closely with Procurement, Project Controls, Contracts, Supply Chain, and Project Management teams to ensure timely processing of supplier invoices, cost allocations, accruals, and project financial reporting.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounts Payable Management**

* Review and process supplier and subcontractor invoices in accordance with contractual terms and company procedures.
* Verify invoice accuracy against purchase orders, goods receipt notes, milestone completion, service entry sheets, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure proper coding and allocation of costs to project cost codes and work breakdown structures (WBS).
* Process vendor payments within agreed payment terms.
* Monitor outstanding invoices and resolve discrepancies promptly.
* Maintain vendor master data and payment records.
* Coordinate with suppliers to resolve invoice and payment\-related queries.
* Prepare monthly project cost reports and financial summaries.
Assist with project close\-out activities and final account reconciliations.  
* 

**Financial Reporting**

* Prepare weekly status reports of assigned invoices.
* Assist in preparation of cost\-to\-complete and estimate\-at\-completion reports.
* Support internal and external audits.

**Systems \& Data Management**

* Maintain accurate financial data within ERP systems.
* Support system improvements and process automation initiatives.
* Ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or related discipline with 12–15 years of Experience.

**Experience**

**Project Accountant**

* 12–15 years of project accounting experience within Oil \& Gas, LNG, Petrochemical, EPC, EPCM, or Energy sectors.

**Accounts Payable Specialist**

* 8–10 years of accounts payable experience supporting large industrial projects.
* Experience with multinational suppliers and project\-based accounting environments preferred.
* Knowledge of project cost control and procurement processes is advantageous.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Project accounting principles.
* Accounts payable processes and controls.
* Financial reporting and reconciliation.
* Purchase order and contract administration.
* Invoice verification and payment processing.
* Taxation, GST/VAT, and withholding tax requirements.
ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, JDE, or Microsoft Dynamics.  
* 

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong accounting and financial analysis skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective verbal \& written communication and stakeholder management.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced project environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Invoice processing cycle time.
* On\-time vendor payment performance.
* Accuracy of project cost reporting.
* Month\-end close completion timeliness.
* Number of invoice discrepancies and resolution time.
* Audit findings and compliance performance.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: EC project Coordinator
description:
JOB PROFILE – ENVIRONMENTAL CLEARANCE (EC) PROJECT MANAGER

**Position:** Environmental Clearance (EC) Project Manager  
**Department:** Environmental Consultancy / Regulatory Affairs  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years in Environmental Consultancy / EC / EIA  
**Reporting To:** Director / Head – Environment / Senior Management

1\. JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced and technically competent **Environmental Clearance (EC) Project Manager** to manage end\-to\-end Environmental Clearance projects under the applicable environmental regulations and regulatory framework.

The candidate will be responsible for **project planning, EC documentation, EIA/EMP coordination, regulatory submissions, consultant coordination, client communication, government liaison, project tracking, quality control, and timely completion of EC projects**.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the **EIA Notification, 2006 and amendments, MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, PARIVESH portal, MPCB requirements, EC procedures, EIA/EMP preparation, public consultation, compliance requirements, and environmental regulatory processes**.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. EC Project Management

* Manage multiple Environmental Clearance projects from initiation to EC grant.
* Prepare project execution plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Monitor project progress against agreed timelines.
* Allocate work among project team members and coordinate with technical experts.
* Identify project risks, delays, and regulatory issues and take corrective action.
* Ensure timely completion and submission of all EC\-related documents.
* Maintain project trackers, status reports, and documentation.
* Conduct regular internal project review meetings.
* Coordinate with management regarding project status, challenges, and critical issues.

B. Environmental Clearance Process

* Handle the complete EC process from **project inception to Environmental Clearance**.
* Understand project applicability, category, schedule, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of:
* Form 1 / Form 1A, wherever applicable
* Pre\-feasibility / conceptual reports
* Terms of Reference (ToR) applications
* EIA Reports
* Environmental Management Plans (EMP)
* Executive Summaries
* Risk Assessment / Disaster Management Plans, wherever applicable
* Environmental Cost Benefit Analysis, wherever applicable
* Additional studies as required
* Coordinate submission and processing of EC proposals through the **PARIVESH portal**.
* Track proposal status and regulatory observations.
* Coordinate responses to queries, deficiencies, additional information requirements, and committee observations.
* Prepare and coordinate compliance to **ToR conditions and EC conditions**.

C. EIA/EMP Coordination

* Coordinate with EIA coordinators, functional area experts, laboratories, GIS teams, and other technical consultants.
* Review baseline environmental monitoring data.
* Coordinate studies related to:
* Air environment
* Water environment
* Noise environment
* Soil
* Ecology and biodiversity
* Traffic
* Socio\-economic environment
* Land use
* Hydrogeology
* Risk assessment
* Solid and hazardous waste
* Review EIA/EMP reports for technical consistency and regulatory compliance.
* Ensure recommendations and mitigation measures are practical and project\-specific.
* Coordinate preparation of environmental management budgets and implementation plans.

D. Regulatory Authority Coordination

* Coordinate with **MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, EAC, MPCB, SPCB, local authorities, and other applicable government departments**.
* Monitor agenda items, meeting schedules, presentations, observations, and decisions.
* Coordinate preparation of presentations for SEAC/EAC/SEIAA meetings.
* Prepare briefing notes and responses for committee observations.
* Attend regulatory meetings along with the project team/client, wherever required.
* Maintain professional communication with regulatory authorities and stakeholders.

E. Client Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for EC\-related matters.
* Understand client requirements, project scope, and regulatory objectives.
* Conduct client meetings and project review discussions.
* Provide regular updates regarding project progress.
* Explain regulatory requirements and technical issues to clients in a clear manner.
* Communicate anticipated delays, additional requirements, and regulatory risks.
* Maintain good professional relationships with clients.
* Support business development by identifying additional environmental consultancy requirements from existing clients.

F. Team Management

* Lead and supervise EC project coordinators and junior environmental professionals.
* Assign responsibilities and monitor individual deliverables.
* Review work prepared by team members before submission.
* Train junior staff regarding EC procedures and documentation.
* Ensure proper coordination between technical, regulatory, documentation, and project teams.
* Maintain accountability for project deadlines and quality.

G. Documentation \& Quality Control

* Review all EC documents before submission.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness, and proper formatting of documents.
* Maintain project\-wise documentation and records.
* Ensure version control of reports and drawings.
* Maintain records of:
* EC applications
* ToR
* EIA/EMP reports
* EC letters
* Compliance reports
* Meeting minutes
* Presentations
* Regulatory communications
* Client communications
* Ensure that all submissions comply with applicable regulatory requirements.

H. EC Compliance \& Post\-EC Activities

* Coordinate preparation of **six\-monthly EC compliance reports**.
* Track EC conditions and implementation status.
* Coordinate with clients for compliance evidence and supporting documents.
* Review compliance reports before submission.
* Coordinate environmental monitoring requirements.
* Track EC validity, compliance schedules, and reporting requirements.
* Assist clients with amendments, transfers, extensions, validity\-related matters, and other post\-EC regulatory requirements.

I. Technical \& Regulatory Knowledge

The candidate should have working knowledge of:

* EIA Notification, 2006 and subsequent amendments
* Environmental Clearance procedures
* MoEF\&CC requirements
* SEIAA / SEAC procedures
* EAC procedures
* PARIVESH portal
* ToR process
* EC amendment procedures
* EC transfer procedures
* EC validity and compliance requirements
* Public consultation / public hearing process
* Environmental monitoring
* EIA/EMP preparation
* Environmental Management Plan
* Risk Assessment and Disaster Management Plan
* Solid Waste Management
* Hazardous and Other Wastes Management
* Plastic Waste Management
* Construction \& Demolition Waste Management
* Water and wastewater management
* Air pollution control
* Noise pollution management
* Greenbelt / plantation planning
* Rainwater harvesting
* STP/ETP/WTP systems
* Environmental monitoring and compliance

3\. REQUIRED SKILLSTechnical Skills

* Strong knowledge of Environmental Clearance procedures.
* Strong understanding of EIA/EMP preparation.
* Ability to interpret environmental regulations and notifications.
* Knowledge of PARIVESH portal and online EC submission.
* Ability to review technical environmental reports.
* Knowledge of environmental standards and applicable legislation.
* Understanding of pollution control technologies and environmental management systems.
* Ability to prepare/review presentations for SEAC/EAC/SEIAA meetings.

Project Management Skills

* Project planning and scheduling
* Team management
* Task allocation
* Deadline management
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Client coordination
* Multi\-project management
* Documentation control
* Quality assurance
* Follow\-up and escalation management

Communication Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong email drafting skills.
* Ability to communicate with clients and government authorities.
* Strong presentation skills.
* Ability to explain technical and regulatory matters clearly.
* Negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills.

Computer Skills

* MS Word – Advanced
* MS Excel – Advanced
* MS PowerPoint – Advanced
* PDF/document management
* PARIVESH portal
* Email and online communication tools
* Basic knowledge of AutoCAD/GIS is an advantage.

4\. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

**Essential:**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in:
* Environmental Engineering
* Environmental Science
* Civil Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Environmental Management
* Ecology / related environmental field

**Preferred:**

* M.Tech / M.E. Environmental Engineering
* M.Sc. Environmental Science
* MBA / PG Diploma in Project Management or Environmental Management

5\. EXPERIENCE

**Preferred experience: 5–10 years**

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred:

* Environmental Consultancy
* Environmental Clearance
* EIA/EMP preparation
* MoEF\&CC / SEIAA projects
* SEAC/EAC coordination
* PARIVESH portal
* MPCB coordination
* Regulatory compliance
* Infrastructure / construction projects
* Township and area development projects
* Mining projects
* Industrial projects
* Water resources / river valley projects

Experience in handling projects independently from **EC application through EC grant** will be highly preferred.

6\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

The EC Project Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Timely completion of EC projects.
* Number of projects successfully processed/granted.
* Quality and accuracy of EC submissions.
* Effective handling of regulatory observations.
* Client satisfaction.
* Reduction in project delays.
* Effective team utilization.
* Timely submission of compliance reports.
* Quality of EIA/EMP documentation.
* Regulatory coordination and follow\-up.
* Successful handling of SEAC/EAC/SEIAA observations.
* Contribution to repeat business and new project opportunities.

7\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

The candidate should be:

* Responsible and accountable.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented.
* Detail\-oriented.
* Strong in follow\-up.
* Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously.
* Comfortable interacting with senior management and clients.
* Professional in dealing with government authorities.
* Able to work under strict deadlines.
* Good at team coordination and leadership.
* Willing to travel for client meetings/site visits/regulatory meetings when required.

8\. PREFERRED PROFILE

An ideal candidate should be capable of independently handling the complete lifecycle of an EC project:

**Client Requirement → Project Understanding → EC Applicability → Documentation → ToR Application → ToR Compliance → Baseline Studies → EIA/EMP → Public Consultation → Final EIA/EMP → PARIVESH Submission → SEAC/EAC/SEIAA Coordination → Presentation → Compliance to Observations → EC Grant → Post\-EC Compliance**

9\. JOB RESPONSIBILITY – SHORT VERSION FOR JOB PORTALS

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage end\-to\-end Environmental Clearance projects.
* Coordinate EC applications, ToR, EIA/EMP reports, and PARIVESH submissions.
* Coordinate with MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, EAC, MPCB, and other regulatory authorities.
* Manage EIA consultants, functional area experts, laboratories, and technical teams.
* Prepare and review EC documentation, presentations, and regulatory responses.
* Track project timelines and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Handle client meetings, project updates, and regulatory discussions.
* Lead and supervise EC project coordinators and junior team members.
* Monitor EC compliance and six\-monthly compliance reporting.
* Identify regulatory risks and provide appropriate solutions.
* Maintain complete project documentation and quality control.
* Support business development and client relationship management.

**Required Skills:** Environmental Clearance, EIA/EMP, PARIVESH, MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, EAC, MPCB, Regulatory Compliance, Project Management, Team Management, Client Coordination, Technical Report Review, Presentation Skills and Excellent Communication Skills.

Pay: ₹22,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
